correctness.rationale: Homogeneity, two Burnside involution counts, and the published finite rotation theorem yield the formulas; edge cases and exhaustive small-poset checks agree.

originality.rationale: Targeted semantic searches found no matching or stronger equivalent; the closest literature supplies the classification and rotation machinery but not these orbit profiles.

value.rationale: The result gives exact profiles for all five random-poset reduct groups and shows ordered triples distinguish the entire lattice.
